title: pentas decora var. triangularis
intro: Pentas decora var. triangularis, commonly known as the Starcluster, is a tropical flowering shrub native to Madagascar, characterized by its clusters of star-shaped flowers in shades of pink to purple. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pentas decora var. triangularis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves, stems, and flowers.
